name: Reachy
dof_breakdown: two 7-DOF arms (Orbita 2D/3D actuators) + 3-DOF Orbita neck; figures for Reachy 2
summary: An open-source humanoid torso — two 7-DOF arms, a 3-DOF 'Orbita' neck and an animated face — on a height-adjustable column or a mobile base, designed for VR teleoperation and manipulation research. Pollen publishes the hardware and software openly; the current model is Reachy 2 (2024), and Pollen was acquired by Hugging Face in 2025.
notable: Fully open-source humanoid hardware and software
Adopted by Hugging Face as an open embodied-AI platform
